scope: Historical measurements recorded for example images currently present in the published mockup asset set. This is not a fresh benchmark or a per-download audit.
limitations: Measurements are copied from historical example manifests; this build helper does not render or remeasure art.
A missing comparison size is reported as unknown. It is not inferred from another panel or from a default.
An image hash is published only when the bytes currently in the published asset directory match the manifest hash.
Artwork IDs group repeated uses of the same example input within this set; source files and their private digests are not published.
The separate comparison is a recorded internal check, not an external audit of the service.

exception.note: This example was rechecked at 1024 px after its 512 px mirror comparison was inconclusive. Both recorded results are retained.
